😊 See you on Friday, Mr. George.

You may visit our office either in the morning between 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM or after 4:00 PM to 5:30 PM. During the mid-period, we will have a management meeting, so we kindly request you to avoid that time to prevent any inconvenience.

Thank you, and we look forward to seeing you.
